grammar_title: 限制性定语从句2:关系副词 when / where / why(及与关系代词的判断)
source: 外研社(新标准)2019必修第一册 Unit 5 Using language:限制性定语从句(关系副词 when/where/why,= 介词+which)。句子地道、野生动物/自然主题,答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.overview: 先行词表时间(day/time/year/moment/season 等)、从句不缺主语或宾语(只缺时间状语)时,用关系副词 when(= 介词+which)。
先行词表地点(place/country/forest/lake 等)、从句只缺地点状语时,用关系副词 where(= 介词+which)。

points.point: why(原因)+ 关系副词 vs 关系代词判断
points.overview: 先行词为 reason、从句缺原因状语时用 why;但若从句缺主语/宾语,即使先行词表时间/地点也要用关系代词 that;介词后只能用 which。

questions.stem: "I still remember the day ____ I first saw a wild eagle in the mountains."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day 表时间,从句不缺主宾(只缺时间状语)→ when。

questions.stem: "Autumn is the season ____ millions of monarch butterflies fly south."
questions.explanation: 先行词 season 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "There was a time ____ these forests were full of wild animals."
questions.explanation: 先行词 time、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "Dawn is the hour ____ most birds begin to sing in the wood."
questions.explanation: 先行词 hour 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "I will never forget the moment ____ the bear suddenly looked straight at me."
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "Spring is the time of year ____ many creatures wake from their long sleep."
questions.explanation: 先行词 time of year → when。

questions.stem: "That was the year ____ the national park first opened to visitors."
questions.explanation: 先行词 year 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "Sunday is the day ____ we usually go bird-watching by the lake."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "He still recalls the night ____ he heard wolves calling across the valley."
questions.explanation: 先行词 night 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "There comes a point ____ a young bird is finally ready to fly."
questions.explanation: point 在此表'时刻'→ when。

questions.stem: "Winter is the season ____ food becomes hard for wild animals to find."
questions.explanation: 先行词 season 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "I remember the morning ____ the whole wetland was covered with cranes."
questions.explanation: 先行词 morning 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "It was an age ____ huge animals like the mammoth still walked the earth."
questions.explanation: age 在此表'时期'→ when。

questions.stem: "That was the moment ____ the eagle spread its wings and rose into the sky."
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment → when。

questions.stem: "Every autumn there is a week ____ the salmon swim back up the river."
questions.explanation: 先行词 week 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "I'll always remember the day ____ I helped to set a wild bird free."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "Summer is the period ____ the young caterpillars feed on the green leaves."
questions.explanation: 先行词 period 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "There was a season ____ this lake was home to thousands of wild ducks."
questions.explanation: 先行词 season → when。

questions.stem: "Sunset is the time ____ the deer come out to drink at the waterhole."
questions.explanation: 先行词 time 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "He often talks about the day ____ he photographed his first wild panda."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "Yellowstone is a park ____ visitors can watch bears in the wild."
questions.explanation: 先行词 park 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: "I have finally found a forest ____ wild deer still feel safe."
questions.explanation: 先行词 forest 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "This is the lake ____ thousands of cranes spend the winter."
questions.explanation: 先行词 lake 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "Mexico is the country ____ the monarch butterflies rest each year."
questions.explanation: 先行词 country 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "That is the valley ____ a family of wolves makes its home."
questions.explanation: 先行词 valley 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "We visited a wetland ____ many rare birds come to feed."
questions.explanation: 先行词 wetland 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "China is a place ____ the giant panda can be seen in the wild."
questions.explanation: 先行词 place → where。

questions.stem: "He showed me the cave ____ the bears sleep through the cold winter."
questions.explanation: 先行词 cave 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "It was a quiet wood ____ I could watch the animals without a sound."
questions.explanation: 先行词 wood 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: "There are still mountains ____ the snow leopard quietly lives."
questions.explanation: 先行词 mountains 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "The zoo is the only place ____ many children ever see a real tiger."
questions.explanation: 先行词 place → where。

questions.stem: "That is the river ____ the salmon lay their eggs every year."
questions.explanation: 先行词 river 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "Africa is a land ____ huge herds of animals still move freely."
questions.explanation: 先行词 land 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "I found a quiet corner of the park ____ the rabbits like to play."
questions.explanation: 先行词 corner 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "This is the field ____ wild flowers feed the hungry caterpillars."
questions.explanation: 先行词 field 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "Canada has forests ____ bears and eagles live close together."
questions.explanation: 先行词 forests 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "Nature is a world ____ every creature has its own special place."
questions.explanation: 先行词 world 表抽象地点 → where。

questions.stem: "That is the island ____ thousands of seabirds build their nests."
questions.explanation: 先行词 island 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "We reached a hidden pool ____ the deer come to drink at dusk."
questions.explanation: 先行词 pool 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "It was a small reserve ____ injured wild animals are cared for."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reserve 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "The reason ____ many monarch butterflies are dying is the loss of plants."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: "There are many reasons ____ animals migrate to warmer places."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reasons → why。

questions.stem: "I finally understood the reason ____ the bear had stared at me so long."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "One reason ____ the red panda is in danger is the cutting of forests."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "That is the main reason ____ we must protect these wild creatures."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "Pollution is the reason ____ fish can no longer survive in this river."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "Nobody knows the real reason ____ the birds changed their usual path."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "There must be a reason ____ so many whales come to this bay each year."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "The day ____ changed my view of wild animals was truly unforgettable."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day 虽表时间,但从句缺主语 → 用关系代词 that(不是 when)。

questions.stem: "The photo ____ I took of the bear later won a national prize."
questions.explanation: 先行词 photo、从句缺宾语 → 关系代词 that。

questions.stem: "The eagle ____ flew over the lake was the largest I had ever seen."
questions.explanation: 先行词 eagle、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: "The forest ____ we visited last spring was full of singing birds."
questions.explanation: 先行词 forest 虽表地点,但从句缺宾语(visited ___)→ 用 that(不是 where)。

questions.stem: "The animals ____ live in this park are protected by law."
questions.explanation: 先行词 animals、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: "The first creature ____ I photographed in the wild was a red deer."
questions.explanation: 先行词 creature、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: "The river ____ runs through the valley is home to many fish."
questions.explanation: 先行词 river、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: "The path ____ we followed led us deep into the dark forest."
questions.explanation: 先行词 path 虽表地点,但从句缺宾语(followed ___)→ 用 that(不是 where)。

questions.stem: "These are the tall trees on ____ the eagles build their huge nests."
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后只能用 which(不可 that)。

questions.stem: "That is the way in ____ the butterflies find their direction south."
questions.explanation: the way in which;介词 in 后用 which。

questions.stem: "A camera is the tool with ____ this photographer captures wild animals."
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指物用 which。

questions.stem: "Sunlight is the means by ____ green plants make their own food."
questions.explanation: a means by which;介词 by 后用 which。
